user.title: Set up
user.description:
Build the configuration step by step or start from the preset of the YAML plan (living room). Progress is saved after every step, so closing this window by accident does not lose it.

{draft}

menu_options.preset_plan: Preset: living room of the YAML plan

global_sensors.title: Outdoor light
global_sensors.description: Optional sensors that tell how bright it is outside. Without them the integration cannot compute the daylight factor.

zone.title: New zone
zone.description: A zone is one room. Pick one of your Home Assistant areas to prefill its name, key, lamps and sensors, or leave the field empty for a custom zone.

new_zone.title: New zone
new_zone.description: A zone is one room. Pick one of your Home Assistant areas to prefill its name, key, lamps and sensors, or leave the field empty for a custom zone.

zone_name.title: Name of the zone
zone_name.description: Area: {area}. The name is shown in Home Assistant; change it if you like. The key is a short latin id used in entity ids and settings; leave it empty to derive it from the name.

zone_sensors.title: Sensors of {zone}
zone_sensors.description: All optional. Without an illuminance sensor the zone uses a daylight-only estimate. Sensors found in the area are prefilled. Several presence sensors are allowed: the zone is occupied if any of them is on.

zone_extra_sensors.title: Extra sensors of {zone}
zone_extra_sensors.description: Only for the behaviour scenarios (fridge, sofa, windows ...). Leave empty if unused.

zone_lamps.title: Lamps of {zone}
zone_lamps.description: Pick the light entities of this zone (lights of the area are prefilled). Each becomes a lamp with its own auto switch.

group_add.title: New lamp group in {zone}
group_add.description: A group shares settings and can be used by scenarios. A lamp may be in several groups.

data.name: Name
data.share_pause: Manual change pauses the whole group

data.name: Name
data.share_pause: Manual change pauses the whole group

params.title: Parameters ({level}: {target})
params.description: Empty field = inherit from the level above (global, zone, group, lamp).

data.need_blind: Need when blinded (no trust in lux)
data.work_hours_only: Switch on only in work hours
data.fridge_block: Do not adjust while fridge zone is active

zone_bindings.title: Behaviour of {zone}
zone_bindings.description: Which groups and lamps the scenarios use. Choose Off to remove a binding. An empty field means the same: that scenario is off.

zone_detect.title: On detection in {zone}
zone_detect.description:
Rules turn lamps on when a sensor trips and, after a delay, off when it clears. An empty list does nothing. The two templates are optional: they only fill the form, nothing is saved until you submit it.

{rules}

menu_options.detect_tpl_room: Template: room presence → main group, adaptive, off 10 min after leave
menu_options.detect_tpl_fridge: Template: fridge sensor → one lamp, fixed 30% at 4500 K, off after 10 s

detect_add.title: Detection rule in {zone}
detect_add.description: One trigger, the lamps, and when to turn them off. Adaptive turns the lamps on and leaves the brightness to the controller. Fixed asks for a brightness and, if you want, a colour temperature. Off delay 0 does not turn the lamps off. A fridge sensor at 30%, 4500 K and 10 s still runs the fridge scenario.

detect_delete.title: Delete a detection rule in {zone}
detect_delete.description: The chosen rule is removed. The others stay.

zone_remove.title: Remove {zone}?
zone_remove.description: Its lamps, groups and sensors are removed from the configuration.

error.duplicate_lamp_entity: The same light is used twice
error.lamp_zone_mismatch: A group mixes lamps of different zones
error.role_zone_mismatch: Sensor role does not fit its zone
error.bad_sensor_domain: The entity type does not fit the role
error.detect_needs_lamps: Pick at least one lamp of this zone
error.detect_needs_sensor: Pick the zone presence or one binary sensor
error.detect_needs_brightness: Pick adaptive, or a fixed brightness
error.detect_no_fridge_sensor: Add the fridge sensor first (extra sensors)
